<documents>
<document id="atm-limits">
ATM withdrawal limits
How much cash you can take out each day depends on your plan. The limit covers all ATMs combined, in the US and abroad.

| Plan | Daily ATM limit |
|---|---|
| Basic | $500 |
| Plus | $1,000 |
| Premium | $1,500 |

The daily limit resets at midnight Eastern Time.

## Can I raise my limit?

No. Limits are set by plan, and support can't raise them for a day or make exceptions. The only way to get a higher limit is to change plan.

## ATM limits versus the ATM's own limit

Many ATMs have their own maximum per withdrawal that's lower than ours. If you need more, you can make more than one withdrawal, as long as the total stays within your daily limit. Each withdrawal outside BrookLink may carry a fee.

Cash withdrawals are never covered by Cushion.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
<document id="transfer-limits-basic">
Transfer limits on Basic
These are the transfer and deposit limits on the Basic plan.

| Limit | Amount |
|---|---|
| ACH transfers out, per day | $2,500 |
| ACH transfers out, per calendar month | $10,000 |
| BrookPay, per day | $1,000 |
| Domestic wires, per day | $5,000 |
| Mobile check deposits, per day | $1,000 |
| Cash deposits at stores, per day | $1,000 |

Daily limits reset at midnight Eastern Time. The monthly limit resets on the first day of each calendar month.

## Incoming transfers

There's no limit on money coming in by ACH, wire, direct deposit or BrookPay.

## New devices

For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, BrookPay and external transfers are capped at $500.

## Need more?

Limits are set by plan. Support can't raise them, even for one transfer. Changing plan is the only way to get higher limits.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.
</document>
<document id="transfer-limits-plus">
Transfer limits on Plus
These are the transfer and deposit limits on the Plus plan.

| Limit | Amount |
|---|---|
| ACH transfers out, per day | $5,000 |
| ACH transfers out, per calendar month | $20,000 |
| BrookPay, per day | $2,500 |
| Domestic wires, per day | $10,000 |
| Mobile check deposits, per day | $2,500 |
| Cash deposits at stores, per day | $1,000 |

Daily limits reset at midnight Eastern Time. The monthly limit resets on the first day of each calendar month.

## Incoming transfers

There's no limit on money coming in by ACH, wire, direct deposit or BrookPay.

## New devices

For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, BrookPay and external transfers are capped at $500.

## Need more?

Limits are set by plan. Support can't raise them, even for one transfer. Changing plan is the only way to get higher limits.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
</documents>
